messages:
maria_pm: quick heads-up: AcmeHealth asked for a tightened Optimize toolkit MVP: adaptive batching + prescriptive cache + a simple quant fallback. they want a pilot in ~6 weeks. thoughts?
aj_eng: 6w is tight. which of the three is non-negotiable for them?
sarah_cs: they ranked batching + cache highest. quantization is optional; docs + manual rollback acceptable.
leo_ml: for quant we can ship int8 recommendation and a documented fp16 fallback. auto-swap needs eval validation.
emily_se: customers want clear runbooks and a small set of eval-triggered signals to auto-fallback. can we define templates now?
tom_product: propose MVP scope:
- adaptive batching presets (mobile-short, server-long)
- cache policy templates (prefix cache, TTL guidance)
- quantization: doc + manual rollback; defer auto-swap post-pilot
aj_eng: need SLO gates: if batching causes >10% p95 regression vs baseline on route, disable batching for that route.
leo_ml: eval alert template to share:
EVAL_ALERT name=token-concordance-drop; trigger_if concordance_delta <= -5% over N=500; action notify #product + rollback-to-baseline
sarah_cs: nice. need short customer-facing acceptance bullets.
maria_pm: draft acceptance criteria:
- Pilot: 3 customers incl. AcmeHealth
- Batching: <=10% p95 latency regression; cost savings >=15% on batched traffic
- Cache: prefix hit-rate >=20% within 2 weeks
- Quant fallback: documented steps; no silent quality regressions (eval alerts enabled)
- Eval alerts: thresholded rules + daily digest to ops
tom_product: rollout: canary 5% (24h), 25% (72h), full; auto-fallback if eval alert fires.
emily_se: docs need examples for mobile and server presets + SDK toggle snippet. I'll draft.
aj_eng: runtime question: mixed batching (short + long) in same pool? changes kernel selection.
leo_ml: runtime can bin by max_seq; config: batching_bucket={"short":32,"long":8} and route metadata selects bin. expose presets mapped to bins.
sarah_cs: legal: cache only for non-PII routes. require route-level consent and opt-out snippet.
maria_pm: add to acceptance: pilot must include explicit route consent and sample opt-out code.
leo_ml: quick eng acceptance plan:
1) baseline on commit X
2) enable batching presets, synthetic 100k requests, measure p95 + cost/token
3) run eval set (2k prompts), compute concordance, verify no eval alert
4) enable cache, measure hit-rate and eviction behavior
5) test quant fallback by swapping int8 artifact and verify quality delta <=2% or rollback
aj_eng: rough estimate: batching+cache core = 4w eng +1w testing/docs; quant fallback+eval hooks = 2-3w; aim to parallelize to hit ~6-8w.
tom_product: prioritization rule: if timeline slips, trim scope by deferring auto-quant swap; ship docs + manual rollback only. keep eval alerts.
emily_se: customer comms: 1-pager, sample config, SDK toggle snippet.
sarah_cs: I'll confirm AcmeHealth stance on staged rollout and surface legal constraints.
maria_pm: action items:
- @aj_eng: create epic + estimates (EOD Fri)
- @leo_ml: author eval-alert templates (Tue)
- @emily_se: draft 1-pager & SDK snippets (Wed)
- @sarah_cs: confirm pilot customers & legal (Thu)
- @tom_product: finalize rollout gating text (Fri)
release-bot: deploy scheduled: optimize-toolkit/pilot-config v0.1 -> staging 2025-02-12T09:00:00Z
maria_pm: thanks all. leaning to greenlight Tom's scope, quant deferred-auto. update tickets and sync Wed 10am for pilot sign-off.
